In the event of an overdose, if the individual has severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call emergency services (911) immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. 9. This medication has been prescribed specifically for your current condition. Do not use it for other conditions unless directed by your healthcare provider. 10. While taking this medication, your doctor may order laboratory tests, such as a complete blood count or kidney and liver function tests, to monitor your health and the medication's effects. 11. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. 12. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Avoid flushing medications down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless instructed to do so. 13. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed.
